Hey there! We are Edily. Edily or Edily Learning is building a short-form video app for Gen-Z learners. We are bringing entertainment to education, think of us like a mix of Khan Academy and TikTok. Edily's Mission is to enable educators to create amazing educational content; these educators will help students find inspiration for learning and will guide them towards their passions.

AND!!! It’s HERE!!! Edily has just launched on Product Hunt and we would love your support! Being an edtech app, it made sense to be introduced to the tech-savvy community of PH.
